sequence.title: Initialization and periodic DHT22 read + UART streaming
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant boot as boot
  participant app_task as app_task
  participant dht_poll as dht_poll
  participant dht22_gpio as dht22_gpio
  participant timer_node as timer_node
  participant dht_stream as dht_stream
  participant _uart as _uart

  boot->>app_task: app_main init, start app_task
  app_task->>dht_poll: create/start polling task (APP_DHT22_POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
  app_task->>dht_stream: create/start streaming task (APP_STREAM_PERIOD_MS)

  loop every APP_DHT22_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
    dht_poll->>timer_node: esp_timer_get_time() for timing
    dht_poll->>dht22_gpio: gpio_config(open-drain + pull-up)
    dht_poll->>dht22_gpio: drive low (start), then release and read pulse widths
  end

  loop every APP_STREAM_PERIOD_MS
    dht_stream->>_uart: write CSV line (optional header)
  end
